facts.value: Are you concerned about the quality of our environment? Do you want to understand more about the global and national challenges of climate change and sustainability? Would you like a career helping to make improvements to our environment for the benefit of this and future generations? Do you want a challenging career and one tailored to meet the needs of a wide spectrum of employers? Then perhaps you should study Environmental Science at UL.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science (Direct Entry)

facts.value: The direct entry route to Year 1 of this degree at UL is via LM066 Environmental Science.
facts.programme_association: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science (Direct Entry)

facts.value: You can also enter LM066 Environmental Science via LM123 Biological and Chemical Sciences Common Entry whereby you choose LM066 Environmental Science as your exit route at the end of Year 1.
